result.brief: 提出运动引导对比正则化，用光流相似度作软对比目标，抑制JEPA潜世界模型中的静态坍缩，提升潜表征对控制相关状态变化的保留。
result.reason: Contributes a motion-guided contrastive regularizer for JEPA-style latent world models, improving action-conditioned latent representations for control; directly addresses representation learning in world models.
